posts.author: muederfuntimez
posts.body:
Right now I am working on my very first rpg maker game so I am using and abusing default assets and dlcs (Obv not gonna charge for the game) but I am struggling to find a face set or an enemy image for these two character sprites because not only did the DLC not come with it (Not that the knights were intended to be enemies) but I can't seem to find any face sets or enemy images even remotely close to these knights which I found kinda odd, I would appreciate it if anybody knew where I could at least find a face set/ enemy image very similar to them. At the very least I need an enemy image, facesets are not really required.
Update: I found a soldier enemy in VX Ace which should work for one of them which is good enough.
Final Edit: I was able to just swap out both of the knight models and use the ones from VX Ace, my issue is officially solved
